verdict.rationale: The evidence presents LaunchDarkly as a hosted SaaS platform, and nothing documents an open-source distribution of the full flag platform that you can self-host. The open-source Relay Proxy does run on your own infrastructure, but it only proxies the LaunchDarkly streaming API, so it is an adjacent component rather than a self-hosted platform. The FedRAMP federal instance is likewise a separate LaunchDarkly-run instance, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can self-host the full flag platform from an open-source distribution, keeping evaluation data on my infrastructure
